title: A Echo for the Terminal
author: Beatrix Delacroix
blurb: Jonah Nakamura, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
